0.0: I have a special order for you. I should warn you, this one is notorious with our agents here in El Nath as one of the most dangerous. I mean, I could do it, but I don't have a sponsor, or the time, or, y'know... Anyway, my job is to deliver orders. So, here you go.
0.1: So, #h0#, are you ready for this?

no.0: Yeah, I figured you were too scared.

1.0: Wait, what? You're done? As in, you did it?
1.1: Whoa! I mean, how did you do that? You don't even look that strong. I... I mean, I could have done it, but, uh, I have all these orders to give out. Heavy orders! With sharp edges! Very dangerous. Anyway, good job or whatever.
